faqs.a:
The membership of the retirement system shall include all police officers as defined
               in this chapter:
(1)
Who are in the employ of the city on the effective date of the retirement system;
                  and
(2)
Who enter city employment after the effective date of the retirement system.
(Code 1960, § 19-4; Code 1981, § 26-4)
